title: The Hunter and the Woodman
summary: A hunter armed with bows and spears walked through the forest, loudly boasting that he was searching for a lion to slay....
full_text:
A hunter armed with bows and spears walked through the forest, loudly boasting that he was searching for a lion to slay.

Meeting a woodman, the hunter asked: "Have you seen any lion's tracks in this valley?"

The woodman replied: "I can do better than show you his tracks; I will lead you straight to the cave where the lion is sleeping!"

The hunter turned pale, his teeth chattering in terror: "No, no! I was looking only for his tracks, not for the beast himself!" and he sprinted down the mountain path in panic.
moral: The boaster is brave in search of the track, but terrified when the beast appears.
